desc:
🐱 Sneak into 15 worlds, steal a cat and RUN home! The cat runs to its giant boss... and the boss WAKES UP!

🌙 NEW: the Eclipse Moon! The Eclipse Lion sleeps on his throne. Steal from him and his lightning will find you!

🏠 Your cats make money on your farm every second, even offline.

👟 Train on your treadmill. The faster you are, the further worlds and rarer cats you can catch.

⚾ Hit a thief with your bat and grab his cat!

⚔️ TITAN ATTACK every 2 hours: fight it together and win heavy cats!

✨ FEATURES
• 15 worlds and 15 giant bosses
• 120 cats, from Common kittens to SECRETS
• A Secret cat every :00 and :30
• 2 rare cats in the Spark Pod = an EXOTIC creature
• Every cat has a weight: heavier = richer
• Merge 3 of the same into 1 heavier cat
• 15 bats, 16 treadmills, 12 speed trails
• Admin events: the Admin Treadmill multiplies YOUR speed
• Money Tree, daily rewards, English and Arabic

👍 Like and ⭐ favourite for more updates!
